slices.title: Add OHDER next action decision engine
slices.description: Create a deterministic engine that converts architect status, refactor governance, replayability risk, and task pressure into a next governed action when no ASK task is ready.
acceptanceCriteria: High replayability or low architecture score returns run-governance-validation.
Healthy architecture with no task pressure returns await-new-requirement.
Active or ready task pressure returns no OHDER override.

slices.title: Integrate OHDER fallback into ask next
slices.description: Teach ask next to preserve existing task-first selection while using OHDER recommendations when no active or ready task exists.
acceptanceCriteria: Ready created tasks still take precedence over OHDER recommendations.
In-progress tasks still take precedence over OHDER recommendations.
No-task blocking architect status returns next.type ohder-action.
The ask next JSON payload includes a compact OHDER decision summary.

slices.title: Emit replayable OHDER next-action evidence
slices.description: Record OHDER fallback recommendations in the event ledger without mutating task state so architecture-driven next actions are replayable.
acceptanceCriteria: An OHDER fallback decision emits OhderNextActionRecommended.
The event payload includes action, reason, architect status, architecture score, blocking flag, and recommended command.
Task-first next selections do not emit OHDER fallback events.
Projection replay remains stable after event emission.

slices.title: Document OHDER-driven next actions
slices.description: Update README and operations docs so operators understand when ask next returns architecture-driven actions and how to respond.
acceptanceCriteria: README explains OHDER-driven next actions and the task-first precedence rule.
Runtime architecture docs map OHDER next actions to the 16-step loop.
Operator playbooks explain resolve-architecture-block, create-refactor-slice, run-governance-validation, and await-new-requirement.
ASK preflight, can-commit, and pre-push checks pass after documentation updates.
